scope: Native 3D support_local for ball, cuboid, capsule, cone, cylinder, convex polyhedron and triangle
tolerance_reason: Public results and simplex weights retain the existing f32 policy. Nonunique active intersection CSO vertices use independent shape-surface, decomposition and origin-containment proofs; their raw differences are still reported. Status, dimensions, indices, copied nonintersection state and guards remain exact.
preconditions: Finite coordinates within the documented validation range; nonzero directions, normalized poses, nonnegative radii and positive cone/cylinder dimensions
Valid nonempty convex vertex ranges; no composite mesh/polyline dispatch in this operation
Cold GJK starts from a native support point with dimension zero and cleared unused state; exact-distance flag is boolean and max distance is finite/nonnegative
invariants: Independent f64 support-function optimality and surface membership
Returned closest points lie in their shapes; separating directions are unit vectors and no-intersection witnesses exceed the requested distance
Intersection result is zero-valued; active CSO vertices decompose into shape-surface points and their convex hull contains the origin
Nonintersection paths preserve the complete supplied simplex exactly; dimensions and previous indices agree exactly
No geometry calculation is substituted on the host between device stages
outside_scope: Warm-started arbitrary input simplexes and production query/runtime integration
Ascend vendor compilation, execution and performance
reference_limitations: Native affine-dependence/repeated-support rejection can return closest points before the relative distance-gap convergence condition is met; the original behavior is preserved
Native GJK has a 100-iteration bound and a no-intersection fallback
